text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The monthly major cleanup was being held on this day.
It appeared that Nishino Flower and Grass Wonder from the Beautification Committee were doing their rounds.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan.
There's no need to be so nervous, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... But today is a very important day of activities for the Beautification Committee!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best to help everyone realize the importance of keeping the academy beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Nishino Flower seems even more psyched up
than usual. Worried, I decided to keep an eye
on her from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I was using that broom, you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's public equipment, right? It doesn't belong to you.
Can't you just go get a new one?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Why do I have to go get it?
Shouldn't you be the one getting it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... both of you...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your enthusiasm regarding the academy's beautification.
However—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful scenery comes from a beautiful heart.
Let us put aside our squabbles for now and continue cooperating with the cleanup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well now, that covers our patrol rounds~.
All that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Grass-san,
thank you so much for earlier!
And, well, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, what should I do to become
as good at this as you, Grass-san?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a dependable Umamusume
who can support everyone even more...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
Everything is a learning experience, but if I had to pick one...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, straighten your back and speak clearly.
If you speak with a dignified presence,
everyone is bound to listen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: As for the rest... what comes next is the most important part.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The importance of cleaning that Flower-chan holds dear...
Let's make sure we convey that properly♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What I hold within me...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if we can manage that, everything will be fine.
Now, shall we head up to the rooftop where the slackers tend to gather?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(A high school division student... and she's angry too...
Kh... but—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um...! Please do some cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Why?
It won't make a difference whether I'm here or not, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... In all things, good results
always stem from a good environment!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I believe a good environment isn't something made for you,
but something you create yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please return to your designated areas and help keep
the grounds clean as usual!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Alright, alright.
I can't say no to that kind of passion...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That settles that.
You spoke so well back there.
...Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"All this time"...?
Um... you mean, you've been watching me all this time?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was powerful and super cool!
Yeah, it was so powerful and cool!
"Good results come from a good environment." That's a great saying.
"Good results come from a good environment." That's a great saying, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"All this time"...?
Um... you mean, you've been watching me all this time?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was powerful and super cool!
Yeah, it was so powerful and cool!
"Good results come from a good environment." That's a great saying.
"Good results come from a good environment." That's a great saying, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I have a long way to go.
I'm nowhere near Grass-san's level.”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To speak in a way that is quiet, gentle, and yet truly reaches people's hearts... That is what I aspire to!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case,
then I must brace myself all the more.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, please, I never meant to trouble you...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's not what I meant.
I just wanted to say,
"Let's keep doing our best together from now on."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Likewise, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
T-Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Those words just came to me during one of my races.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The freshly maintained turf felt so good.
And my times improved significantly, too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"That's when it hit me!
'A good environment produces good results!'"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see. I certainly learned something new.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all, the pleasure is all mine...!
I learned so much today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems both of them were able to learn something from each other.
